[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#purpose]

## Purpose

The SCR review evaluates **Solution Cost Input** submissions to ensure ITO has sufficient information to produce an accurate infrastructure cost estimate. This is an infrastructure-focused review that validates completeness, consistency, and feasibility of hosting requirements before ITO sizing begins.

---
page_texts.5:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#what-scr-reviews]

### What SCR Reviews

- **Hosting model and tenancy** requirements are clearly defined
- **Compute and storage** sizing is specified or workload characteristics provided
- **Disaster recovery and availability** targets are consistent and achievable
- **Networking and connectivity** requirements are complete with bandwidth and connection types
- **Data migration** scope is defined (if applicable)
- **Third-party licensing** and monitoring requirements are captured
- **Cross-section consistency** — DR tier matches availability, compliance matches hosting, etc.
page_texts.6:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#what-scr-does-not-review]

### What SCR Does NOT Review

- Business justification or ROI (that's CRB)
- Detailed application architecture or code design (that's ARB)
- Security architecture beyond data classification and compliance requirements
- Vendor selection or technology decisions

---
page_texts.7:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#expected-content-style]

## Expected Content Style

- **Infrastructure-focused**: Concrete sizing, quantities, and measurable requirements
- **Specific**: Actual values (TB, vCPU, Mbps) or clearly described workload characteristics
- **Consistent**: Values across sections must align (DR type matches availability, databases have storage)
- **Complete**: ITO should not need follow-up questions to produce an estimate
- **Practical**: "Unknown — ITO to recommend" is acceptable where justified
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#red-flags]

### Red Flags

- All sizing fields left blank without workload descriptions
- Availability target inconsistent with DR architecture (e.g., 99.99% with Backup & Restore)
- FedRAMP compliance selected but hosting is not GovCloud
- Databases listed without storage sizing
- Required environments marked but no sizing percentage
- No diagrams showing infrastructure components
- Azure-specific services listed with AWS hosting (or vice versa)

---

## Scoring Dimensions

| # | Dimension | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Project Information & Completeness | 10% |
| 2 | Solution Architecture & Hosting | 20% |
| 3 | Compute & Storage Sizing | 20% |
| 4 | Disaster Recovery & Availability | 15% |
| 5 | Security & Compliance | 10% |
| 6 | Networking & Connectivity | 15% |
| 7 | Data Migration & Licensing | 10% |

> For detailed criteria, section mappings, and diagram requirements, see the [processing rules file](../../resources/processing-rules/scr-rules.json).

page_texts.12:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#cross-section-consistency-checks]

## Cross-Section Consistency Checks

The SCR rules include automated consistency validation across sections:

| Check | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Availability ↔ DR Alignment | 99.99% requires Active-Active; Backup & Restore only valid for ≤99.0% |
| Compute ↔ Environment Alignment | All required environments must have sizing percentages; prod must be explicitly sized |
| Database ↔ Storage Alignment | Every database needs a size estimate; HA databases need DR replication approach |
| Compliance ↔ Hosting Alignment | FedRAMP requires GovCloud; FTI requires isolation; HIPAA requires encryption |
| Networking ↔ Hosting Alignment | AWS uses Direct Connect (not ExpressRoute); Azure uses ExpressRoute (not Direct Connect) |

---
page_texts.13:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/scr-requirements.md#passfail-rules]

## Pass/Fail Rules

- **Overall weighted score >= 75%** → READY FOR ITO SIZING
- **Overall weighted score < 75%** → INCOMPLETE — REQUIRES ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- Individual dimension scores are **informational only** — they do NOT independently cause rejection
- Per-section status shows ✅ COMPLETE or ⚠️ INCOMPLETE for transparency, but the overall decision is driven solely by the overall score
